description: This file contains the implementation of a PDO Firebird driver and related classes for the ADOdb database abstraction library in PHP. It defines the main driver class 'ADODB_pdo_firebird' with methods for server information, metadata retrieval (tables, columns, indexes, primary keys), sequence management, and query limit handling. It also includes record set classes tailored for Firebird, including array-based fetches.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_firebird
classes.description: Main class implementing PDO Firebird driver extending ADODB_pdo_base with methods for server info, metadata, sequences, and query limit control.

classes.name: ADRecordSet_pdo_firebird
classes.description: Record set class for PDO Firebird, providing field fetching capabilities.

classes.name: ADRecordSet_array_pdo_firebird
classes.description: Array-based record set class optimized for Firebird, supporting seek operations and field metadata.

methods.name: serverInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the Firebird server, including dialect version.

methods.name: metaTables
methods.description: Returns a list of tables in the database.

methods.name: metaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for columns of a specified table.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Fetches index information for a given table.

methods.name: metaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Gets primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a SQL sequence in Firebird database.

methods.name: genId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves next value from a sequence.

methods.name: selectLimit
methods.description: Applies limit and offset to a SQL query for Firebird.
